coverage: Five manually reviewed public location references from four Certified B Corp companies. South Island pilot covering accommodation, food and drink, guided tours and retail; not a complete directory or AVES supplier list.

records.name: Lake Hāwea Station

certification.scopeNote: B Lab lists Lake Hawea Station under mixed farming. Company certification does not separately certify each stay or farm experience.

location.address: 22 Timaru Creek Road, Lake Hāwea, New Zealand
location.precision: Public contact address reference, not accommodation entrance

records.limitations: Arrange visits with the operator. Tourism New Zealand lists accommodation at 62 Timaru Creek Road; this pin represents the operator’s published contact address at 22, not an arrival point. Company certification does not confirm availability or certify each experience. No AVES partnership.

records.name: Wild Kiwi Christchurch departure

certification.scopeNote: B Lab names Danai Ltd and links Wild Kiwi. This is company certification, not certification of the departure hotel, each vehicle, guide or included activity.

location.address: Wyndham Garden, 64 Kilmore Street, Christchurch, New Zealand
location.precision: Published tour departure address reference, not an office or confirmed pickup

records.limitations: Wild Kiwi publishes this hotel as the Christchurch meeting location for selected premium tours. Confirm the meeting place and time for your booked tour directly with Wild Kiwi. This marker does not certify Wyndham Garden or offer a standalone transport service. No AVES partnership or booking is confirmed.

accessReview.method: Individual public profile and owner-page review. Minimal factual names, addresses and source links only; no copied descriptions or logos. Individual OpenStreetMap address lookups, with attribution.
accessReview.bulkAccess: Not assessed or authorised; no scrape, bulk download, API request, credential or automated directory importer.
